terms.comment: The modern green and kidney beans are an American species that inherited the ancient name (Phaseolus vulgaris, Linn.); Ep. VII uses phasēlī of Baba’s garden. The bean words divide cleanly: faba is the ancient broad bean, phasēlus the pod bean whose name the American Phaseolus inherited, pīsum the pea.

sources: Theodōrus et pater: Ep. III (cicer in the cēna rūstica, with the gloss legūmen rotundum), Ep. IV (lēns, faba, cicer in the cella penāria), Ep. VII (phasēlī in Baba’s garden).
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 71; p. 336.
